item.text:
The audit now has 20 confirmed findings. This pass added:

- **Empty `logger_file_path` panics during build.** With logging enabled, the empty path passes configuration validation, then `build()` panics because `Path::parent()` returns `None` and is unwrapped: [audit_logger_path.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_logger_path.rs).
- **The persistent-storage defect was strengthened.** The same stale-log-key corruption occurs through direct `append_entries`; a later write can commit a failed transaction, and the leaked entry remains after closing and reopening RocksDB.
- **Crash/restart stress produced no new safety violation.** The randomized run completed 18 crashes across 2,488 proposals with no decided-index conflict.

The runtime all-features suite, default workspace checks, and shipped default tests remain clean aside from the documented audit reproductions. Full findings, commands, and retained outputs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
